title: 第74章 谁不准他们还钱，就是他们的仇人！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 唐敬一副有子万事足的样子，很享受别人对唐画的恭维。　　毕竟三元及第的状元他们没有，他唐敬有。　　唐画也非常享受被众星捧月的感觉，当即就被捧得飘飘然了，以至于心头那点忧虑，当场就被他甩到了九霄云外。　　再者，他已经找到了对付唐逸的大杀器！　　姜云娜！　　唐逸不是自幼对这个女人有意思吗？那就让这个女人，彻底毁了他。　　“诸位叔伯放心，晚辈一定不会让那小诗仙为所欲为，沈园诗会，我必定将他踩在脚下，为诸位叔伯出一口气。”　　唐画冲着众人拱手，自信笑道。　　“好，有信心就好，如此我们便放心了。”　　“很好，唐家小子，只要你能将那小诗仙踩在脚下，将狄苍那老匹夫的脸，按在地上摩擦，以后仕途老夫捧着你。”　　“陛下不是想要捧着小诗仙吗？这一次我们便让他在陛下面前，摔得稀巴烂。”　　“……”　　众人见到唐画脸上洋溢的自信，也都笑着附和起来。　　唐敬看着这一幕，脸上满是欣慰，这个宝贝大儿子，为他攒够了脸面。　　“唐敬，等下散了你别走，咱俩单聊下。”　　这时，刘温的声音在耳畔响起。　　唐敬鲜少看到刘温如此愤怒过，当然愤怒也正常，谁让他没有一个三元及第的儿子呢。　　“刘大人有事？老夫今日还想早回，毕竟马上就是沈园诗会了，还得教育一下唐画。”　　唐敬笑着拱手，只是笑容多少有点玩味和嘲讽。　　“教育唐画之前，你可能得先教训一下你那怨种小儿子吧？”　　刘温盯着唐敬，目光瘆人：“你那小儿子狂妄到让我儿子跪下叫爷爷，这是你唐大人的意思呢？还是他的意思？”　　“如果是你唐大人的意思，那处理完小诗仙，咱们就拉开阵势干一仗。”　　他堂堂一个户部尚书，高出了唐敬整整一个品阶，还怕唐敬一个吏部侍郎？　　闻言，唐敬的眉心顿时跳了跳。　　这几日唐逸仗着梁绍的帮助，在幻音坊三局残诗敲开三大花魁大门的消息，已经传遍了整个京都，成了京都热门话题之一。　　而在这场交锋中，刘州被唐逸逼着跪地叫了爷爷。　　这就是赤裸裸的打户部尚书府的脸了！　　“刘大人放心，这件事我会给你个交代的。”　　唐敬的好心情顿时烟消云散，目光也变得锐利起来，冲着刘温微微颔首。　　脑海中不知为何想到了唐逸，想到了唐逸的话。　　他说他是小诗仙，还说唐画的科举有问题。　　呵，笑话！　　那是他手把手教出来的大炎第一好少年，怎么可能做出那种无耻的事情。　　分明就是这混账嫉妒哥哥优秀，故意想要乱我的心，让我们父子心生嫌隙！　　心思极其恶毒。　　不能再放任他了，否则唐家的脸都快被他丢光了。　　就在这时，刘温的管家快步上了楼，走到刘温的耳边低声说了几句。　　刘温听完管家的汇报，看向唐敬的目光充满嘲讽：“唐敬，刚刚得到消息，你儿子唐逸刚刚破了户部左侍郎顾城的案子。”　　“他刚刚和一处的人勘察了现场，现在将证据都搬回了北镇抚司。”　　“这事，你怎么看？”　　唐敬已经知道唐逸成了锦衣卫的事，只是他并未在意，这肯定是陛下为了敲打他，同时可怜唐逸，才给了唐逸一个身份罢了。　　不足为患。　　看到众人的目光也都看了过来，唐敬摆了摆手冷笑一声，声音带着轻蔑道：“不怎么看，破案？他还没这个本事。”　　“无非锦衣卫一处找不到证据，故意打草惊蛇拿唐逸说事，说他找到了证据。”　　“其目的，无非就是让真凶去北镇抚司销毁证据罢了。”　　说到这里，唐敬眯着双眼看向刘温，道：“怎么？户部的案子，难道和刘大人有关？”　　刘温脸色骤然一沉，道：“难道和唐大人没关系吗？唐大人前前后后可是借了户部五万两。”　　“顾城死了，唐大人就只需要还三千两，还是说唐大人正义凛然，不想和我等同流合污，会把五万两原封不动还给陛下。”　　唐敬听到这话笑容渐渐收敛：“嗯，这么说来那他还是死吧！”　　然而，让唐敬脸色难看的，是刘温的话当场给了他一闷棍，将他给打得清醒了。　　要不是刘温提醒，他都忘记自己从户部借了五万两的事。　　那么问题来了，他从户部借了五万两，柳如玉留下了五万两的巨额财产，这才短短三年的时间，唐家现在连几百两都拿不出来了。　　这又是怎么回事？　　唐敬莫名的有些发慌。　　但很快，他又觉得是自己想多了。　　颜霜玉毕竟是小门小户出来的，抠搜得厉害，银子应该是被她藏起来了。　　唐家要是只剩下几百两了，前几日如何花一万多两，在天香楼大摆宴席的？！　　而众人听完唐敬的话，也都彻底放心了。　　他们都从户部借了银子，也在顾城那里做了假账，要是真让唐逸查出真相，将真账本查了出来，那后果不堪设想。　　他们要多还数十倍的银子，那还的是银子吗？那是他们的命！　　刘温睨了众人一眼，叹了口气义正词严道：“诸位，大家都是朝廷的股肱之臣，都要脸面，拿了国库银子的，还是都还回去吧！”　　“陛下也不容易，如今北狄大军压境，东虞又蠢蠢欲动。”　　“老夫不忍陛下这般操劳，会做表率将户部的一万两还回去，再卖田卖地砸锅卖铁筹集五千两捐献给陛下，助大炎渡过难关。”　　众人闻言，脸皮都在轻微抽搐，国库的银子，就你刘温监守自盗拿得最多。　　账面上就拿了二十万两，要不算账面的，估计三十万两都有了！　　现在，你还像个忠臣一样，还一万两砸锅卖铁捐五千两，简直不要太无耻。　　“嗯，刘大人说得对，为君分忧，是我们这些做臣子的本分，本官还五千两捐三千两。”　　“哎，都是为了大炎的繁华昌盛，本官欠国库的三千两，明日到账。”　　“陛下现在缺钱缺粮，作为臣子确实不能坐视不理，那本官的五千两也全部还回去吧，也……也捐一千两，以示诚意。”　　“……”　　众人也都纷纷附和，义正词严。　　那架势，谁敢不让他们还户部的银子，就是他们最大的仇人！
content_en: Tang Jing looked like he had a son and everything was ready, and he enjoyed the compliments given to Tang Hua.After all, they don’t have the number one scholar in three yuan, Tang Jing does.Tang Hua also enjoyed the feeling of being held in high esteem by all the stars. He was immediately so ecstatic that the worries in his heart were thrown away by him on the spot.Furthermore, he has found a great weapon to deal with Tang Yi!Jiang Yunna!Hasn't Tang Yi been interested in this woman since he was a child?Then let this woman completely destroy him."Uncles, don't worry. I will not let the little poetry fairy do whatever he wants. I will step on him at the Shenyuan Poetry Club to save my uncles." Tang Hua raised his hands to everyone and said with a confident smile."Okay, it's good to have confidence, so we can rest assured." "Very good, Tang family boy, as long as you can trample that little poetry fairy under your feet, press that old man Di Cang's face on the ground and rub it, and I will support your career in the future.You." "Your Majesty, don't you want to hold the little Shixian in your arms?This time we will let him fall to pieces in front of His Majesty." "..." Everyone saw the confidence on Tang Hua's face and laughed in agreement.Tang Jing looked at this scene with a face filled with relief. This precious eldest son had saved enough face for him."Tang Jing, don't leave until after we part. Let's chat alone." At this time, Liu Wen's voice rang in his ears.Tang Jing had rarely seen Liu Wen so angry. Of course, it was normal to be angry. Why didn't he have a son with a Sanyuan grade?"Is there anything Mr. Liu? I want to go back early today. After all, the Shen Yuan Poetry Club is about to start, and I have to educate Tang Hua." Tang Jing smiled and handed over his hands, but his smile was somewhat playful and sarcastic."Before educating Tang Hua, you may have to teach your resentful little son a lesson first, right?" Liu Wen stared at Tang Jing with a scary look: "Your little son is so arrogant that he asked my son to kneel down and call him grandpa. Is this what you, Mr. Tang, meant? Or is it?"What does he mean?""If it's what you, Mr. Tang, do, let's start a battle after dealing with the little Shixian."He is a minister of the Ministry of Finance, a whole level higher than Tang Jing, so he is afraid of Tang Jing, a minister of the Ministry of Civil Affairs?Hearing this, Tang Jing's eyebrows suddenly jumped.In the past few days, the news that Tang Yi, with the help of Liang Shao, knocked on the door of the three major oirans in the third game of Huanyinfang, has spread throughout Kyoto and has become one of the hot topics in Kyoto.During this confrontation, Liu Zhou was forced by Tang Yi to kneel down and call him grandpa.This is the face of the Minister of Household Affairs who is nakedly attacking!"Don't worry, Mr. Liu, I will give you an explanation for this matter." Tang Jing's good mood suddenly disappeared, his eyes became sharp, and he nodded slightly at Liu Wen.For some reason, I thought of Tang Yi and what Tang Yi said.He said that he was a little poet, and that there was something wrong with the imperial examination of Tang paintings.Ha, what a joke!That was the best young man in Dayan whom he had taught by hand. How could he do such a shameless thing?It’s clear that this bastard is jealous of my brother’s excellence and deliberately wants to mess with my heart and make our father and son feel bad!The mind is extremely vicious.We can't let him go any longer, otherwise the Tang family will be embarrassed by him.At this moment, Liu Wen's housekeeper quickly went upstairs, walked up to Liu Wen and whispered a few words in Liu Wen's ear.After Liu Wen listened to the butler's report, he looked at Tang Jing with mocking eyes: "Tang Jing, I just got the news that your son Tang Yi just solved the case of Gu Cheng, the left minister of the Ministry of Revenue."They all moved back to Beizhen Fusi." "What do you think about this?" Tang Jing already knew that Tang Yi became a Jinyiwei, but he didn't care. His Majesty must have given Tang Yi an identity in order to beat him and pity Tang Yi.Not enough to cause trouble.Seeing that everyone was looking over, Tang Jing waved his hands and sneered, his voice full of contempt and said: "You don't think much of it, solving the case? He doesn't have the ability yet." "It's just that Jin Yiwei couldn't find any evidence and deliberately raised eyebrows to make things against Tang Yi., saying that he found evidence."The purpose is just to let the real murderer go to Beizhen Fusi to destroy the evidence."At this point, Tang Jing narrowed his eyes and looked at Liu Wen and said, "What? Is the case at the Ministry of Revenue related to Mr. Liu?"His face suddenly darkened, and he said, "Doesn't it have nothing to do with Mr. Tang? Mr. Tang borrowed 50,000 taels from the Ministry of Finance before and after." "Since Gu Cheng is dead, Mr. Tang only needs to pay back 3,000 taels. Or should I say that Mr. Tang is just and awe-inspiring and doesn't want to be complicit with me?"Return the fifty thousand taels intact to Your Majesty." When Tang Jing heard this, his smile gradually faded: "Well, then he should die!" However, what made Tang Jing look ugly was Liu Wen's words that gave him a sap on the spot, which knocked him awake.If Liu Wen hadn't reminded him, he would have forgotten that he borrowed 50,000 taels from the Ministry of Household Affairs.Then here comes the problem. He borrowed 50,000 taels from the Ministry of Household Affairs, and Liu Ruyu left a huge fortune of 50,000 taels. In just three years, the Tang family can't even get out a few hundred taels.What's going on?Tang Jing was inexplicably panicked.But soon, he felt that he was thinking too much.After all, Yan Shuangyu came from a small family and was very picky. She must have hidden the money.If the Tang family only had a few hundred taels left, how could they spend more than 10,000 taels on a big banquet at Tianxiang Tower a few days ago?!After listening to Tang Jing's words, everyone was completely relieved.They all borrowed money from the Ministry of Accounts and made false accounts from Gu Cheng. If Tang Yi really found out the truth and found out the real account books, the consequences would be disastrous.They have to pay back dozens of times more silver. Is that the money they are paying back?That's their life!Liu Wen glanced at everyone, sighed and said sternly: "Everyone, we are all ministers of the imperial court, and we all have face. Those who have taken money from the treasury should return it all!" "It is not easy for your majesty. Now that the Beidi army is pressing on the border, Dongyu is ready to make a move."I can't bear your Majesty's hard work. I will set an example and return the 10,000 taels from the Ministry of Household Affairs, and then sell the land, sell pots, and sell iron to raise 5,000 taels to donate to Your Majesty to help Dayan tide over the difficulties."Everyone's face twitched slightly when they heard this. The money from the treasury belongs to you, Liu Wenjian.
title_en: Chapter 74 Anyone who doesn’t allow them to pay back the money is their enemy!
